about: How readings of one measure combine when a line reads more than one: a count and a size add up, a longest is the longest, and a measure the wire names no combination for is refused rather than summed.

cases.name: showings add up: a ticket shown at the gate twice is shown 2 times
a longest is the longest, never the sum of files
no readings of a longest is none
one reading of any measure is itself
two readings of an undeclared measure are refused
